_instructions: To add a sermon: copy any episode object and update the fields. spotifyId comes from the Spotify episode URL (the part after /episode/). date must be YYYY-MM-DD. transcript is optional freetext or HTML; leave empty string if not yet written. To add a new series: add an object to the series array; the page will generate the section and filter chip automatically. rssUrl: paste your podcast RSS feed URL here (from Buzzsprout / Anchor / Podbean dashboard) to enable auto-detection of new episodes.

episodes.title: Psalm 22: Psalms Jesus Fulfilled and Quoted
episodes.description: Exploring how David's words of suffering and trust anticipate the suffering of Christ and find their fulfilment in the promises revealed in the New Testament. Extended: includes baptism testimony.

episodes.title: Acts 28
episodes.description: Paul reaches Rome after shipwreck and proclaims the kingdom of God with boldness despite chains. From Malta's kindness to witness in the empire's heart, God's purposes advance and his word remains unhindered.

episodes.title: Acts 27
episodes.description: Paul's voyage to Rome is overtaken by storm and shipwreck, yet through trial and danger God preserves every life on board, demonstrating his sovereign care amid uncertainty.

episodes.title: Acts 26
episodes.description: Paul gives his defence before King Agrippa. He recounts his former life, his encounter with the risen Christ, and his mission to proclaim repentance and resurrection hope to all.

episodes.title: Acts 25
episodes.description: Paul stands before the new governor Festus. Facing renewed accusations, Paul appeals to Caesar, and Festus consults King Agrippa about the case, highlighting the dispute over Jesus' resurrection.

episodes.title: Acts 24
episodes.description: Paul makes his defence before the Roman governor Felix, speaks of faith in Christ and the hope of the resurrection, and remains in custody as the legal process unfolds.

episodes.title: Psalms 42 & 43: Look Up When You Are Down
episodes.description: Giving voice to deep spiritual longing and distress, while calling God's people to honest lament, renewed hope, and confidence in the Lord who remains their help and their God.

episodes.title: Galatians 4:8–31: Slave or Son
episodes.description: Paul contrasts slavery and freedom, urging believers to live as children of promise rather than returning to bondage.

episodes.title: Psalm 90
episodes.description: Reflecting on the eternal nature of God, the brevity of human life, and the call to live wisely before him.

episodes.title: Psalm 104
episodes.description: Celebrating God's wisdom and power displayed in creation, and calling his people to praise the Lord who sustains all life.

episodes.title: Psalm 103: New Year — Thankfulness
episodes.description: Calling God's people to remember his mercy, faithfulness, and enduring grace as the new year begins.

episodes.title: Advent 4: Love
episodes.description: Reflecting on God's light and love revealed in the coming of Christ into the world.
